diff_text:
revision: 8, parent: 7, author: "LOX-ψ", domain: "nethack", reason: "High starvation rate at d1 with many episodes exceeding 10k turns without finding food. Increasing nutrition.food_radius_hungry to ensure the agent searches more aggressively for food when starving, and slightly reducing nutrition.pray_routine to provide more frequent hunger relief via prayer in desperate situations."
set nutrition.food_radius_hungry = 120
set nutrition.pray_routine = 750

args: SELECT episode_id, death_message, total_turns, max_depth FROM episodes WHERE death_category = 'starvation' OR death_mess
